how_to_read_it.eleven_is_the_ceiling: each unwired metric shows 11 because 11 is the number of target periods whose original is saved. The other 39 periods report SOURCE_MISSING_TARGET_ORIGINAL first, so the same metric is unwired there too and does not show in this count. Wiring all eight would move 88 positions today and 8 x 50 = 400 once the originals exist.
how_to_read_it.first_blocking_reason_is_not_the_only_on: 1170 positions report a missing original, and some of them also lack a route. The two are counted separately for that reason.
how_to_read_it.what_this_does_not_say: nothing here is a statement that a wired route produces a correct value. Route, Run, public row and content acceptance are four separate states and only the first is counted here.

so_the_next_implementation_is.not_started_yet_and_why: routing a metric edits historical_results.py, which is a rule file, so it moves the Requirement closure. A batch is running against the current one and is the evidence for it; changing the closure underneath the report it will produce would make that report describe a version nothing ran. The order is: finish the batch, report it against its own closure, then wire C04.
so_the_next_implementation_is.why: it is the only one of the eight whose inputs both already have historical routes, so it composes rather than builds.

no_route_at_all.note: these are exactly the amendment policy's nine not_covered_metric_ids minus D02. Not a coincidence - they are the debt composition, capacity, proxy-dependent governance and semantic routes, which is the same reason the amendment policy will not clear them automatically.

structural_applicability_only.what_that_means: the Spec's own applicability and the registry's traits answer the question where the metric does not apply, and that is a real answer - N_A_STRUCTURAL, not a missing route. Where it does apply there is still no route: B10 and B11 for the one lodging company account for 6 of the 94.

blocked_on_a_model_allowance.note: this is a second allowance, not the SEC one. The acquisition plan's cap covers requests to SEC and says nothing about provider calls.
blocked_on_a_model_allowance.why: D01 is source_mode ai_text; B13, D03 and D04 resolve through the semantic review path. None of them can produce a historical value without provider calls, and Issue #47 has no allowance of its own - the same missing record the SEC gate names.

blocked_on_material.not_in_the_cap: the acquisition plan does not include these proxies, because an unwired route has no dependency to declare. They enter the plan when a route does.
blocked_on_material.why: both read the annual meeting DEF 14A. The saved submissions indexes list 85 proxies across the ten companies and ten are saved, all filed in 2026, so a historical C02 or C03 would resolve the most recent period and name a source gap for every earlier one. The missing proxies are the ask rather than the route - which is what historical_text_input already says about C02.

unblocked_deterministic.B06: source_mode structured_first_ai_fallback, so the structured path comes first and several variants of it exist (v3 through v6). More guards than any other metric, so cheapest is not the same as easiest.
unblocked_deterministic.C04: source_mode structured, disclosure_group auditor_report. Its resolver auditor_change_dual_source_v1 reads the AuditorName concept and the fiscal 8-K item 4.01 set - and both already have historical routes, the Company Facts one and the registered-event one whose window separation landed this round. This is the cleanest one to wire.

the_8_unwired_are_not_one_kind_of_work.why_this_cut_matters: 'eight routes to write' reads as eight units of the same work. Read from each metric's own Spec, they are three different blockers and only one of them is implementation.

what_this_is: The part of the frame that is not waiting for a document. Measured over the whole 10 x 39 x 5 frame with no runs root, so the numbers are about routes rather than about any batch.
